}\n    }\n  }\n  ```\n- `input_text_buffer.append`: Send text chunks for TTS generation\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"type\": \"input_text_buffer.append\",\n    \"text\": \"Hello, this is a test.\"\n  }\n
